piezas.titular: From a half-solved Erdős problem to a 1946 conjecture disproved by AI
piezas.entradilla: In November 2025, people celebrated an AI system having single-handedly proved a mathematical problem that had been open for some 30 years. It turned out to be partial progress; in 2026, AI is producing results that mathematicians accept as sound.
cuerpo: On 30 November 2025, ChatGPT-IA-edu shared as “a good example of how far AI can go” the news that [Aristotle](https://harmonic.fun/), a mathematics-focused system from the company Harmonic, had proved Paul Erdős’s problem 124. The proof was written in [Lean](https://lean-lang.org/), a language that lets a computer check every step.

The result was smaller than it seemed: the [record of AI contributions to Erdős problems](https://github.com/teorth/erdosproblems/wiki/AI-contributions-to-Erd%C5%91s-problems), kept in the repository of the mathematician Terence Tao, lists it as a “partial result”.

In 2026 the step has been a different one. In January, problem 728 was solved with GPT-5.2 Pro and checked with Aristotle, although a similar earlier piece of work was later found. On 20 May, [OpenAI announced](https://openai.com/index/model-disproves-discrete-geometry-conjecture/) that an internal model, not available to the public, had disproved the unit distance conjecture that Erdős posed in 1946, with a proof reviewed by mathematicians outside the company.

According to [Quanta Magazine](https://www.quantamagazine.org/why-the-legendary-erdos-problems-are-falling-to-ai-20260803/) (3 August 2026), most of the results came from amateurs and students using public models. It also reports the warning of the person in charge of the database: papers of 100 to 200 pages generated with AI, which no one has read, are in circulation.

piezas.ilustracion_alt: Diptych split by a vertical line. On the left, “Nov. 2025”: a document labelled “Problem 124” and a half-filled circle labelled “Partial”. On the right, “Today”: the same document, labelled “1946 conjecture”, with a blue verification seal.
repaso: Problema 728: quitado «sin que apareciera una demostración anterior»; la wiki de Tao anota un trabajo previo similar (Pomerance, 2014) hallado el 5-6 de enero de 2026.
«Casi 30 años» pasa a «unos 30 años» (el mensaje dice «más de 30», el tuit «casi 30»).
Quanta: fechada la afirmación y acortada para ajustar la medida (~248 palabras); «modelos públicos» en lugar de «al alcance de cualquiera».
piezas.comprobado: Mensaje 43024 (ChatGPTedu, 30-11-2025) verificado en t.me: Aristotle, problema 124, «más de 30 años». Wiki de teorth/erdosproblems: problema 124 (29-11-2025) «Partial result (Lean)»; problema 728 (6-1-2026, Aristotle y GPT-5.2 Pro) «Full solution (Lean)», con literatura previa similar de Pomerance (2014). Anuncio de OpenAI abierto (20-5-2026): conjetura de distancias unitarias de Erdős (1946), modelo interno, verificada por matemáticos externos. Quanta (3-8-2026) abierto: 728 resuelto hacia el 4-1-2026 con GPT-5.2 Pro y comprobado con Aristotle; mayoría de resultados de aficionados y estudiantes con modelos públicos; advertencia de Bloom sobre artículos de 100 a 200 páginas sin leer. harmonic.fun abierta (Aristotle, de Harmonic). Tema no repetido en el último mes ni en publicado.txt; sin enlaces pieza:.
